description: The first 10K fully animated Ordinal collection on Fractal Bitcoin. 10,000 unique pixel-art birds, inspired by the CC0 Moonbirds universe. In 2022, Moonbirds went CC0 — the birds flew free. Now, under a FULL MOON, they have landed on Fractal Bitcoin. Fully animated. Fully on-chain. Forever.
name: FULL🦉MOONBIRDS
